The '''Old Barag system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Epsi Collective/Legends|Epsi Collective]], within [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]],<ref name="EAOC" /> that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Old Barag/Legends|Old Barag]],<ref name="Twitter" /> [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Baragwin/Legends|Baragwin]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare" />
